name: mnilwhy1
label: 1st mention cause of mental illness feelings

questions.text:
(IF NO TO EVBRKDWN, ASK EVMHP) Have you ever felt you had a mental health problem?
A. (IF YES TO EVMHP ASK:) Could you tell me about when you felt that way?  What was it about? (PROBE: GET EXACT DATE and complete details.) 
A1. The causes and sources of R's mental illness -- First mention.

questions.text:

B1. What R. did about the mental illness -- First mention.
